title: Lithuanian Bible portions, 'Tikinčiųjų paveldo vertimas' (Believers' heritage translation), one verse per line
notes: License: 'cc-by-sa' is stated for translation id 'lit' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/lit/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 861,996 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'lithuanian') gives 736,057 characters. Only part of the Bible carries text (7,099 non-empty verses).
